taskPurpose.exactNormativeText: The system builds point-in-time deployer, creator, mint-authority, metadata-authority, initial-funder, LP-controller, and migration-controller profiles.
Launch histories include security failures, liquidity removals, creator sales, token lifetime, peak and tradable outcomes, supply distribution, migration behavior, and entity-confidence limits.
Address splitting and indirect funding paths are analyzed through bounded graph traversal with system-address exclusions and uncertainty labels.

Deployer archetypes are descriptive evidence, never proof; critical historical abuse may suppress alerts, while repeat success may only increase research priority after independent current-token validation.
Unknown or low-coverage creator history is represented as unknown, not safe.
